annotations.title: Draft the posts in my plan

description: Write every post in this week's post plan as a draft, in the user's own voice, saved to their brain as a note per post and linked to the plan. Posts that already have a draft are left as they are. Use for 'write the posts in my plan', 'draft this week's posts', 'write them all'. For one post from finished work that is not on a plan, use the restate skill instead. Nothing is posted to LinkedIn: the user copies the draft and posts it. error no_plan means there is no plan this week, so offer to make one first. Link each draft as [subject](/graph/object/<object_id> "note") and say they can edit anything, then end with [See your week](/linkedin/manager), the page where they can read, copy and schedule each one.
name: draft_my_planned_posts
title: Draft the posts in my plan
